note: Independent evidence for the EPA sole-offering rules (epa_sole.py). Each entry matches rules by EPA make, a regex on the EPA baseModel/model names, displacement (null = a model-year-wide rule), optional cylinders and drive, and the model years it speaks to. verdict: supports (counted when nothing disagrees), conflicting (not counted), contradicts (dropped), weak_support (not counted: sale-listing or forum text only). 'via' says how the text was read: sources first read by a sibling worklist are quoted from that worklist's JSON (its rule id is given); sources found in this step were read through WebSearch result text on 2026-11-05 (WebFetch could not reach outside hosts from this session), so they carry the search tool's summary, not a page quote. Verification pass 2026-11-05 (epa_sole_verify.py): Liberty 2.4 2003-2005 and Wrangler TJ 2.4 2005-2006 set to 'contradicts', Cougar 2.0 2001-2002 set to 'conflicting'; see each entry's note.

entries.note: The rule reads vPIC's decoded displacement. In the decode cache vPIC returns 1.0L 3-cyl only for VIN character 8 = '6' and only on hatchbacks (every Metro sedan decodes 1.3L, codes 9/2), which matches GM's MY1999-2000 filings (6 = 1.0L L3 TBI Suzuki, LP2) and the 3-cylinder being hatchback-only. The GM worklist held MY1995-1998 as VIN-rule candidates only because the MY1995-1998 filings' code column is unreadable.
